description: Meteor FR.9 preserved outside the Base Aérea Cotopaxi entrance, marked FF-114 (Wikipedia: ex RAF WB136; the photographer suggests it is ex FAE-704 wrongly marked with its c/n) — jetphotos 25 October 2020. Wikipedia also lists a second Meteor, FF-112 ex WH547, at this base (unconfirmed).
T-33A c/n 580-1593, FAE 639, preserved on the base wearing the false serial FAE369, together with a DC-3 and a Mirage F1 (jetphotos 25 October 2020).
